name: Méabh's Indenture

parties.label: Méabh
parties.wording: The labourer shall work indefinitely for the employer under the standard takeling charter.

parties.label: The Morrigan
parties.wording: The employer shall provide housing and sustenance to the labourer under the standard takeling charter.

wording: Méabh shall work indefinitely for the Morrigan as an indentured worker.
